
# CE

## Number of trips summary

```{r ce-trips-total}
CEtr <- CE %>%
  group_by(CEyear) %>%
  summarise(
    CEnumFracTrips = sum(CEnumFracTrips, na.rm = TRUE),
    CEnumDomTrip   = sum(CEnumDomTrip,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

CEtr1 <- CEtr %>%
  pivot_longer(c(CEnumFracTrips, CEnumDomTrip),
               names_to = "NumberofTripsSource", values_to = "NumberofTrips")

ggplot(CEtr1, aes(CEyear, NumberofTrips, fill = NumberofTripsSource)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  RDBES_FILL +
  rdbes_theme() +
  ylab("Number of trips") +
  labs(fill = "Trip source")

rdbes_dt(CEtr, caption = "Total fractional and dominant trips by year")
```

```{r ce-trips-scatter}
ggplot(CE, aes(CEnumFracTrips, CEnumDomTrip)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, colour = "#66a182") +
  facet_grid(. ~ CEyear) +
  rdbes_theme() +
  xlab("Fractional trips") +
  ylab("Dominant trips")
```

### By gear

```{r ce-trips-gear}
CEg <- CE %>%
  group_by(CEmetier4, CEyear) %>%
  summarise(
    CEnumFracTrips = sum(CEnumFracTrips, na.rm = TRUE),
    CEnumDomTrip   = sum(CEnumDomTrip,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  select(CEyear, CEmetier4, CEnumFracTrips, CEnumDomTrip)

rdbes_dt(CEg, caption = "Number of dominant and fractional trips by gear and year")

CEg1 <- CEg %>%
  pivot_longer(c(CEnumFracTrips, CEnumDomTrip),
               names_to = "CEtripssource", values_to = "CEtrips")

CEg1 %>%
  group_by(CEmetier4, CEtripssource) %>%
  mutate(TotT = sum(CEtrips, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(CEmetier4, -TotT), CEtrips, fill = CEyear)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(CEtripssource ~ .) +
  RDBES_FILL +
  rdbes_theme() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("Gear") +
  ylab("Number of trips") +
  labs(fill = "Year")
```

## Fishing days

```{r ce-fishdays-total}
CEfd <- CE %>%
  group_by(CEyear) %>%
  summarise(CEsciFishDay = sum(CEsciFishDay, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

rdbes_dt(CEfd, caption = "Total scientific fishing days by year")
```

```{r ce-fishdays-scatter}
ggplot(CE, aes(CEsciDaySea, CEsciFishDay)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7, colour = "#66a182") +
  facet_grid(. ~ CEyear) +
  rdbes_theme() +
  xlab("Scientific days at sea") +
  ylab("Scientific fishing days")
```
